literal: Simon Peter, servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who obtained, in the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ, a faith equal in honor to us:
prose: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a faith equal in honor to ours through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:

literal: Grace to you and peace may it be multiplied in [the] knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
prose: Grace and peace be multiplied to you in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

literal: as all things to us of his divine power the things toward life and godliness having granted, through the knowledge of the [one] having called us through glory and excellence,
prose: seeing that his divine power has granted us all things pertaining to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us through glory and excellence,

literal: through which the precious and very great to us promises he has granted, so that through these you may become of divine nature partakers, having escaped from the in the world in desire corruption
prose: through which he has granted us his precious and very great promises, so that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world because of desire

literal: And this very thing, besides, having brought in all diligence, supply you in your faith virtue, and in virtue knowledge,
prose: and for this very reason, applying all diligence besides, supply in your faith virtue, and in virtue knowledge,

literal: and in knowledge self-control, and in self-control endurance, and in endurance godliness,
prose: and in knowledge self-control, and in self-control endurance, and in endurance godliness,

literal: and in godliness the brotherly affection, and in brotherly affection the love;
prose: and in godliness, brotherly affection, and in brotherly affection, love;

literal: For these things, [you] having them and increasing, render [you] neither idle nor unfruitful unto the of the Lord of us Jesus Christ full knowledge.
prose: For these qualities, being present in you and increasing, render you neither idle nor unfruitful unto the full knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

literal: For [he] with whom these things are not present is blind, being short-sighted, having taken forgetfulness of the cleansing of his of-old sins.
prose: For whoever lacks these things is blind, being short-sighted, having forgotten the cleansing of his former sins.

literal: Wherefore, rather, brothers, be eager your calling and election firm to make; for these things doing, you shall not ever stumble.
prose: Therefore, brothers, be all the more eager to make your calling and election sure; for if you do these things, you will never stumble.

literal: For thus richly will be supplied to you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of the Lord of us and Savior Jesus Christ.
prose: For in this way, richly, entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be supplied to you.

literal: Wherefore I will be about always to remind you concerning these things, although knowing [them] and having been established in the present truth.
prose: Therefore I will always be ready to remind you about these things, although you know them and are established in the truth you now hold.

literal: But right I consider [it], for as long as I am in this the tent, to be stirring up you in reminder,
prose: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by way of reminder,

literal: knowing that swift is the putting off of the tent of me, just as also the Lord of us Jesus Christ made clear to me;
prose: knowing that the putting off of my tent is swift, just as our Lord Jesus Christ also made clear to me,

literal: But I will be eager also at each time [for] you to have, after my departure, to make a remembrance of these things.
prose: But I will also make every effort at each time for you to have, after my departure, a means of remembering these things.

literal: For not by cleverly devised myths, having followed [them], did we make known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but having become eyewitnesses of that one's majesty.
prose: For it was not by following cleverly devised myths that we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but by having become eyewitnesses of his majesty.

literal: For having received from God [the] Father honor and glory, when there was borne to him such a voice as this by the majestic glory, "This is the Son of me, the beloved of me, this one, in whom I am well pleased," —
prose: For he received honor and glory from God the Father, when such a voice as this was borne to him by the majestic glory: "This is my Son, my beloved, in whom I am well pleased" —

literal: And this voice we ourselves heard borne from heaven, being with him on the holy mountain.
prose: And we ourselves heard this voice borne from heaven, being with him on the holy mountain.

literal: And we have [it] more sure, the prophetic word, to which you do well paying attention, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until [the time] of which the day may shine through and the light-bringing [star] may rise in your hearts;
prose: And we have the prophetic word made more sure, to which you do well to pay attention, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

literal: This first knowing, that every prophecy of scripture of [its] own interpretation not comes to be,
prose: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of scripture arises from one's own interpretation,

literal: For not by will of man was borne prophecy at any time, but by Holy Spirit being borne men spoke from God.
prose: For prophecy was never brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God, being carried along by the Holy Spirit.

literal: But there arose also false prophets among the people, as also among you there will be false teachers, who will bring in alongside heresies of destruction, and the Master who bought them denying, bringing upon themselves swift destruction;
prose: But there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will also be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction;

literal: And many will follow after their debaucheries, on account of whom the way of the truth will be blasphemed;
prose: And many will follow their debaucheries, on account of whom the way of truth will be blasphemed;

literal: And in greediness, with fabricated words, they will make merchandise of you; for whom the judgment [that is] from of old is not idle, and their destruction is not nodding [asleep].
prose: And in their greed they will exploit you with fabricated words, for whom the judgment [pronounced] long ago is not idle, and their destruction is not asleep.

literal: For if God did not spare angels having sinned, but having cast [them] into Tartarus with chains of nether-gloom delivered [them], being kept for judgment,
prose: For if God did not spare the angels who sinned, but cast them into chains of nether gloom, consigning them to Tartarus, to be kept for judgment,

literal: and [if] he did not spare [the] ancient world, but guarded Noah eighth, a herald of righteousness, having brought a flood upon a world of ungodly [people],
prose: and did not spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah, a herald of righteousness, one of eight, when he brought a flood upon a world of ungodly people,

literal: and [the] cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, having turned to ashes [them], he condemned [them] with destruction, having set [them as] an example of things about to be to ungodly [people],
prose: and turning to ashes the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, he condemned them to destruction, having made them an example of what is coming to the ungodly,

literal: and rescued righteous Lot, being worn down by the conduct in licentiousness of the lawless ones —
prose: and rescued righteous Lot, worn down by the licentious conduct of the lawless —

literal: for by sight and by hearing that righteous [man], dwelling among them, day out of day was tormenting [his] righteous soul with [their] lawless deeds —
prose: for that righteous man, dwelling among them, day by day tormented his righteous soul by what he saw and heard of their lawless deeds —

literal: the Lord knows [how] to rescue [the] godly out of trial, but to keep [the] unrighteous, being punished, for a day of judgment,
prose: the Lord knows how to rescue the godly out of trial, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

literal: Audacious [ones], self-willed [ones], glories they do not tremble [at], reviling [them], — and especially those going after [the] flesh in desire of defilement and despising lordship.
prose: Audacious, self-willed, they do not tremble at glorious beings, reviling them; especially those who go after the flesh in the desire of defilement and despise lordship.

literal: whereas angels, being greater in strength and power, do not bring against them [before the Lord] [a] reviling judgment.
prose: whereas angels, though greater in strength and power, do not bring against them a reviling judgment before the Lord.

literal: But these, as irrational animals, having been born [by] nature for capture and destruction, blaspheming in the things in which they are ignorant, in their destruction will also be destroyed, being wronged [as the] wage of wrongdoing;
prose: But these people, like irrational animals born by nature for capture and destruction, blaspheming in matters they do not understand, will also be destroyed in their own destruction, suffering harm as the wages of their wrongdoing;

literal: Considering pleasure the luxury in the daytime [to be], spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceits, feasting together with you,
prose: Counting the daytime revelry a delight, they are stains and blemishes, reveling in their deceits as they feast together with you,

literal: eyes having full of an adulteress and unceasing of sin, enticing unstable souls, a heart having trained of greed, children of a curse,
prose: having eyes full of adultery and unceasing in sin, enticing unstable souls, having a heart trained in greed, children of a curse,

literal: Abandoning the straight way they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam of Beor, who loved a wage of unrighteousness
prose: Abandoning the straight way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness

literal: but received a rebuke of his own transgression: a speechless beast of burden, having spoken with man's voice, restrained the madness of the prophet.
prose: but received a rebuke of his own transgression: a speechless donkey, speaking with a man's voice, restrained the prophet's madness.

literal: These are springs waterless and mists by a storm being driven, for whom the gloom of the darkness has been kept.
prose: These men are waterless springs and mists driven by a storm, for whom the gloom of darkness has been reserved.

literal: For [words] swollen of vanity uttering, they entice in the desires of the flesh, in debaucheries, the [ones] barely escaping the [ones] living in error,
prose: For, uttering bombastic words of vanity, they entice with the desires of the flesh, with debaucheries, those who barely escape from people living in error,

literal: promising to them freedom, they themselves being slaves of corruption; for by whatever [thing] someone has been overcome, to this [thing] he has been enslaved.
prose: promising them freedom, while they themselves are slaves of corruption; for by whatever a man has been overcome, to this he has been enslaved.

literal: For if, having escaped the pollutions of the world in knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, but again having been entangled in these [same things], they are being overcome, the last things have become to them worse than the first [things].
prose: For if, having escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in these same things and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

literal: For [it] would have been better for them not to have come to know the way of righteousness than, having come to know [it], to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them,
prose: For it would have been better for them not to have come to know the way of righteousness than, having come to know it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

literal: Has happened to them the [thing] of the true proverb: "A dog, having returned to its own vomit," and, "A sow, having washed [herself], to a wallowing of mire."
prose: What has happened to them fits the true proverb: "A dog returning to its own vomit," and, "A sow that has washed [herself, returns] to wallowing in the mire."

literal: This already, beloved, second to-you I-write letter, in which I-stir-up of-you in remembrance the sincere mind,
prose: Beloved, this is already the second letter I am writing to you, in both of which I stir up your sincere mind by way of reminder,

literal: to-be-reminded of-the beforehand-spoken words by the holy prophets, and of-the of-the apostles of-you commandment of-the Lord and Savior,
prose: that you should remember the words spoken beforehand by the holy prophets, and the commandment of the Lord and Savior given through your apostles,

literal: this first knowing, that will-come upon last of-the days in mockery mockers, according-to the own desires of-them going
prose: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, going after their own desires

literal: and saying: Where is the promise of the coming of-him? For from which [time] the fathers fell-asleep, all-things thus continue, from [the] beginning of-creation.
prose: and saying, "Where is the promise of his coming? For since the fathers fell asleep, all things have continued the same, just as they were from the beginning of creation."

literal: For it escapes them, this, wishing [it]: that heavens were of old, and an earth out of water and through water standing together by the of God word,
prose: For this escapes their notice, since they wish it so: that heavens existed long ago, and an earth formed out of water and through water by the word of God,

literal: through which [waters] the then world, having been deluged with water, perished;
prose: through which the world at that time, being deluged with water, perished;

literal: But the now heavens and the earth, by the same word having been stored up, are, being kept for fire unto a day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
prose: But the heavens and the earth that now exist have been stored up by the same word, kept for fire until the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

literal: But this one thing let it not escape [the notice of] you, beloved, that one day with [the] Lord [is] as a thousand years, and a thousand years [is] as one day.
prose: But do not let this one thing escape you, beloved, that with the Lord one day is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

literal: The Lord of the promise does not delay, as some consider [it] slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing some to perish, but all to make room for repentance.
prose: The Lord is not slow about his promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing any to perish, but all to come to repentance.

literal: But [the] day of [the] Lord will come as a thief, in which the heavens with a roar will pass away, and [the] elements, burning, will be dissolved, and earth and the works in it will be found.
prose: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, in which the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the elements, burning, will be dissolved, and the earth and the works in it will be found out.

literal: Of these things, thus all being dissolved, what sort ought [you] to be [you] in holy conduct and godliness,
prose: Since all these things are thus to be dissolved, what sort of people ought you to be in holy conduct and godliness,

literal: awaiting and hastening the coming of the day of God, through which heavens being set on fire will be dissolved, and elements burning are melting
prose: awaiting and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens, being set ablaze, will be dissolved, and the elements, burning, will melt

literal: But new heavens and new earth, according to his promise, we await, in which righteousness dwells.
prose: But according to his promise we await new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

literal: Therefore, beloved, expecting these things, be diligent spotless and blameless to be found by him in peace,
prose: Therefore, beloved, since you await these things, be diligent to be found by him spotless and blameless, in peace,

literal: and the patience of our Lord regard [as] salvation, just as also our beloved brother Paul according to the wisdom given to him wrote to you,
prose: and regard the patience of our Lord as salvation, just as also our beloved brother Paul wrote to you according to the wisdom given him,

literal: as also in all [his] letters speaking in them concerning these things, in which are some things hard to understand, which the unlearned and unstable twist, as [they twist] also the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
prose: as he does also in all his letters, speaking in them concerning these things, in which there are some things hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable distort, as they do also the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.

literal: You, therefore, beloved, knowing beforehand, guard [yourselves], lest, having been carried away together with the error of the lawless [ones], you should fall out of your own steadfastness,
prose: You, therefore, beloved, knowing this beforehand, guard yourselves, so that you may not be carried away with the error of lawless men and fall from your own steadfastness,

literal: but grow in grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him [be] the glory both now and unto [the] day of [the] age.
prose: but grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity.
